name: WiredNYC – Certified Buildings
description:
This dataset lists New York City buildings certified under the WiredNYC program, which rates a building's readiness for broadband and telecommunications service. Each row represents one certified building and includes its name, address, borough, and certification class, along with identifiers such as BBL, BIN, census tract, community board, NTA, postcode, and council district, plus latitude and longitude for mapping.

Most of the remaining columns describe the building's connectivity infrastructure and provider access: the number of carriers, availability of coax cable, fiber, and satellite or fixed wireless connections, fiber distribution, internet service providers (two ISP fields), multiple points of entry, designated and additional telecom space, riser space for current and additional providers, diverse riser locations, signed points of entry, agreements, and new service providers. The sample covers 51 buildings, so it is a subset rather than a complete citywide inventory.

The data could be used to compare broadband readiness across buildings and neighborhoods, map connectivity infrastructure
